scanNote:
14-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (100-bet) - KO'ChIRMA GAPLAR.

Yuqorida chapda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '14' va 'Live and Let Live'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: Reported Statements'.
8) a) 'Study the examples, then answer the questions.' JADVAL: Direct Speech: 'I WANT to help.' (ayol surati, pufak) 'What tense is the verb in bold?' | Reported Speech: 'She SAYS (that) she WANTS to help.' Savollar: • Which is the reporting verb? What tense is it in? • Are the tenses in reported speech the same as in direct speech? • How has the pronoun I changed in reported speech? • Why is THAT in brackets?
   b) 'Now study these examples and answer the questions.' JADVAL: Direct Speech: 'I WANT to help.' | Reported Speech: 'She SAID (that) she WANTED to help.' Xuddi shu savollar.
   KO'K-YaShIL QUTI 'Changes in Tenses in Reported Speech': 'When the REPORTING VERB is in the PRESENT TENSE, the VERB TENSES from direct speech DO NOT CHANGE in reported speech. When the REPORTING VERB is in the PAST TENSE, the verb tenses in direct speech CHANGE in reported speech.'
9) 'Study the table and say how the verb tenses usually change when we change direct speech into reported speech.' TO'Q SARIQ JADVAL: Direct Speech | Reported Speech: 1 "She IS wrong," he said. | He said (that) she WAS wrong. 2 "It'S RAINING heavily," she said. | She said (that) it WAS RAINING heavily. 3 "He HAS GONE to New York," they said. | They said (that) he HAD GONE to New York. 4 "She LEFT early," said Frank. | Frank said (that) she HAD LEFT early. 5 "I'LL JOIN the action group," she said. | She said (that) she WOULD JOIN the action group.

O'NG USTUN:
   KO'K-YaShIL QUTI 'Say - Tell': 'We use SAY and TELL both in direct and reported speech. We use SAY with or without a personal pronoun. We use TO after SAY when there is a personal pronoun. We always use TELL with a personal pronoun. We never use TO with tell.' To'q sariq qiya: '"It's raining heavily," he SAID. He SAID (that) it was raining heavily. He SAID TO ME (that) it was raining heavily. (less common) He TOLD US (that) it was raining heavily.'
10) 'Fill in said or told.' 1 He ...... us that there are only 1,000 giant pandas left in China. 2 "Soon there will be no gorillas left," he ...... . 3 She ...... me that she was right. 4 He ...... that he'd never seen a panda before. 5 Billy ...... to me, "I'm going to the zoo tomorrow." 6 "I can't help you," she ...... me.
11) 'Rewrite the sentences in reported speech.' 1 "It's the best trip I've ever been on," Sally said. 2 "I'll never forget it," John said to me. 3 "I've found my camera," Scott said. 4 "I didn't enjoy the film very much," Bob said. 5 "It's boiling hot outside," Jean said. 6 "It's getting colder and colder," Ann told us.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '100'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP - birovning gapini
qayta aytib berish.


8a - REPORTING VERB HOZIRGI ZAMONDA
('says'):
  'I want' → 'she WANTS'
  ⚠ Zamon O'ZGARMAYDI (present →
  present).
  ⚠ Olmosh o'zgaradi: I → she.
  ⚠ 'that' - ixtiyoriy (tushirish
  mumkin).


8b - REPORTING VERB O'TGAN ZAMONDA
('said'):
  'I want' → 'she WANTED'
  ⚠ Zamon O'ZGARADI (present →
  past).


⚠ 'A REPORTING VERB':

  = ko'chiruvchi fe'l (say, tell,
  ask ...).


⚠ 'DIRECT SPEECH':

  = to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap
  (qo'shtirnoqda).


⚠ 'REPORTED SPEECH':

  = ko'chirma gap.


⚠ 'IN BRACKETS':

  = qavsda.

items.en: a) What tense is the verb in bold ('want')?
a) Which is the reporting verb? What tense is it in?
items.uz: a) Ko'chiruvchi fe'l qaysi? U qaysi zamonda?
items.answerEn: 'Says'. It is in the present simple.

items.en: a) Are the tenses in reported speech the same as in direct speech?

items.answerEn: Because it is optional - we can leave it out.
items.answerUz: Chunki u ixtiyoriy - tushirib qoldirish mumkin.

items.en: b) Which is the reporting verb? What tense is it in?
items.uz: b) Ko'chiruvchi fe'l qaysi? U qaysi zamonda?
items.answerEn: 'Said'. It is in the past simple.

items.en: b) Are the tenses in reported speech the same as in direct speech?

exercises.instructionEn: Changes in Tenses in Reported Speech. Say - Tell.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'chirma gapda zamon o'zgarishi. Say - Tell.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP QOIDALARI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ZAMON O'ZGARIShI                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Reporting verb HOZIRGI zamonda
  (says) → zamonlar O'ZGARMAYDI.
  Reporting verb O'TGAN zamonda
  (said) → zamonlar O'ZGARADI
  (bir qadam orqaga):

  present simple → past simple
    is → was
  present continuous → past
  continuous
    is raining → was raining
  present perfect → past perfect
    has gone → had gone
  past simple → past perfect
    left → had left
  will → would
    will join → would join


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SAY yoki TELL?                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SAY - olmoshsiz yoki 'TO' bilan:
    He SAID (that) ...
    He SAID TO ME (that) ... (kam)
  TELL - har doim OLMOSh BILAN,
  'to' YO'Q:
    He TOLD US (that) ...

  ⚠ 'He told that' ✗
  ⚠ 'He said me' ✗
  ⚠ 'He told to me' ✗


⚠ 'HEAVILY':

  = kuchli (yomg'ir).
  'raining heavily' = jala.


⚠ 'AN ACTION GROUP':

  = faollar guruhi.

points.en: When the reporting verb is in the present tense, the verb tenses from direct speech do not change in reported speech.
points.uz: Ko'chiruvchi fe'l hozirgi zamonda bo'lsa, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapdagi zamonlar ko'chirma gapda o'zgarmaydi.

points.en: When the reporting verb is in the past tense, the verb tenses in direct speech change in reported speech.
points.uz: Ko'chiruvchi fe'l o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapdagi zamonlar ko'chirma gapda o'zgaradi.

points.en: We use say with or without a personal pronoun. We use to after say when there is a personal pronoun. "It's raining heavily," he said. He said (that) it was raining heavily. He said to me (that) it was raining heavily. (less common)
points.uz: 'Say' ni olmosh bilan yoki olmoshsiz ishlatamiz. Olmosh bo'lsa, 'say' dan keyin 'to' ishlatamiz. "Jala quymoqda", - dedi u. U jala quyayotganini aytdi. U menga jala quyayotganini aytdi. (kamroq)

points.en: We always use tell with a personal pronoun. We never use to with tell. He told us (that) it was raining heavily.
points.uz: 'Tell' ni har doim olmosh bilan ishlatamiz. 'Tell' bilan hech qachon 'to' ishlatmaymiz. U bizga jala quyayotganini aytdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table and say how the verb tenses usually change when we change direct speech into reported speech.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapni ko'chirma gapga o'zgartirganimizda fe'l zamonlari odatda qanday o'zgarishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZAMON O'ZGARIShI (bir qadam
orqaga):

  1 is → was
    (present simple → past simple)
  2 is raining → was raining
    (present cont. → past cont.)
  3 has gone → had gone
    (present perfect → past
    perfect)
  4 left → had left
    (past simple → past perfect)
  5 will join → would join
    (will → would)

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ present simple → past simple: is → WAS.

pairs.right: She said (that) it was raining heavily.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ present continuous → past continuous: is raining → WAS RAINING.

pairs.left: "He has gone to New York," they said.
pairs.right: They said (that) he had gone to New York.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ present perfect → past perfect: has gone → HAD GONE.

pairs.right: Frank said (that) she had left early.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ past simple → past perfect: left → HAD LEFT.

pairs.left: "I'll join the action group," she said.
pairs.right: She said (that) she would join the action group.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 told (us)
  2 said (olmoshsiz)
  3 told (me)
  4 said (olmoshsiz - 'that')
  5 said (to me)
  6 told (me)


⚠ QOIDA:
  olmosh BOR, 'to' YO'Q → TOLD
  olmosh YO'Q → SAID
  'to' + olmosh → SAID


⚠ 'LEFT' (bu yerda):

  = qolgan. 'only 1,000 pandas
  LEFT' = faqat 1000 panda qolgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in reported speech.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 Sally said (that) it WAS the
    best trip she HAD ever been on.
    (is → was; I've → she had)
  2 John told me (that) he WOULD
    never forget it.
    (said to me → told me; I'll →
    he would)
  3 Scott said (that) he HAD FOUND
    his camera.
    (I've found → he had found; my
    → his)
  4 Bob said (that) he HADN'T
    ENJOYED the film very much.
    (didn't enjoy → hadn't enjoyed)
  5 Jean said (that) it WAS boiling
    hot outside.
    (is → was)
  6 Ann told us (that) it WAS
    GETTING colder and colder.
    (is getting → was getting)


⚠ OLMOShLAR HAM O'ZGARADI:
  I → he/she; my → his/her.


⚠ 'SAID TO ME' → 'TOLD ME':

  Ko'chirma gapda 'told me' tabiiy.


⚠ 'COLDER AND COLDER':

  = tobora sovuqroq.

items.textEn: 1 "It's the best trip I've ever been on," Sally said. → Sally said (that) ___.
items.answer: it was the best trip she had ever been on
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'it WAS the best trip SHE HAD ever been on'.

items.textEn: 2 "I'll never forget it," John said to me. → John told me (that) ___.
3 "I've found my camera," Scott said. → Scott said (that) ___.
4 "I didn't enjoy the film very much," Bob said. → Bob said (that) ___.
items.answer: he hadn't enjoyed the film very much

items.textEn: 5 "It's boiling hot outside," Jean said. → Jean said (that) ___.
6 "It's getting colder and colder," Ann told us. → Ann told us (that) ___.
items.answer: it was getting colder and colder

patterns.exampleEn: "I'm tired," he said. → He said (that) he was tired.
Ann told us (that) it was getting colder.
He said to me (that) it was raining.
She says (that) she wants to help.

items.note: ⚠ betda shu; 'more and more' uzun sifatlar bilan
